title: Failed Python rekey can erase replay floor while retaining old trust
description: LinkLayer._rotate_remote_unlocked rotates ReplayProtector state before SchcSessionManager.rotate_remote; the latter can raise (for example generation exhaustion). On failure the old key remains pinned/trusted while its replay window and high-water floor have been deleted, allowing previously accepted signed frames to replay. Make rekey a true preflighted/transactional commit across replay state, SCHC sessions, pins, generations, and persistence, or permanently fail closed after any partial mutation. Add injected failure-boundary tests proving either complete old state preservation or complete new-state commit, never trusted old identity with a lowered replay floor.
